design.dataFlow: validated csm-review-findings/1 -> validate source identity/redaction -> csm-review/lib/findings-render.mjs normalized typed model -> existing csm-render-profile/1 runtime profile mapped from logical csm-review-human/1 -> format-specific projection descriptor -> renderMarkdown or renderHtml -> publish callback/storage
design.determinism: Require injected generatedAt and projectionId seed/explicit ID; sort findings by the authoritative sortKey and preserve stable location/challenge order. Use separate descriptor objects for Markdown and HTML.
informationArchitecture: Summary: source artifact, verification status, overall finding count, severity counts, repository commit
Findings: one deterministic table/list row per finding with ID, severity, confidence, evidence class, status, and title
Finding detail: locations, anchor/CVSS metadata where present, explanation, impact, remediation, and fix actions
Review evidence: challenge verdicts and dissent presence/status only; redacted rationale/command/result values are marker or omitted by policy
Provenance: source artifact/run/owner/digest, renderer/profile identity/digests, generatedAt, untrusted-presentation status
design.mappingRule: The adapter is the sole owner of field selection, ordering, redaction treatment, and accessible labels. It may use table/list/text items; links and code items are not used for findings fields unless a fixture proves a field-specific need.

profileIdentity.rule: Do not put csm-review-human/1 in projection.profile until the generic runtime explicitly supports that identity; the lean path retains it in the producer contract and maps it to the validated runtime profile.

design.rollback: Before integration, preserve the existing generic renderer/publication behavior. If the findings path fails, remove only the new csm-review adapter/profile/entrypoint/tests and restore the generated payload from the previous canonical pack after parity checks; do not alter canonical findings discovery or legacy history.
design.security: Validate findings before mapping; render values only as escaped typed text/list/table content; reject raw HTML/Markdown interpretation; retain HTML fixed allowlists/CSP/URL policy; never expose redacted nested values as ordinary text.
